$comment: SealLink v1.0 Safe-by-Design Off-Chain Locator URI Scheme Registry (SPEC-00 §5, SPEC-03 §4). Extensible via lightweight Registry Update without a breaking Core SLIP.

ssrf_protection_rules.notes: Normative SSRF guard for any automatic off-chain fetch initiated from untrusted manifest, card, mirror, or profile-section locators. Verifiers MUST resolve DNS, reject prohibited IP ranges on every hop before connecting, enforce response byte ceilings, and verify SHA-256 content addressing before parsing.

allowed_schemes.description: TLS-authenticated HTTPS fetch (optionally pinned with tls_spki_sha256); cleartext http:// is forbidden.
BitTorrent v2 (BEP 52) magnet URI carrying btih/btmh infohash parameters.
NIP-19 bech32 Nostr entity URI (nevent1, naddr1, note1, npub1, nprofile1).
SSH File Transfer Protocol locator without embedded credentials (authentication is out-of-band).
